description.value: Brightside Blueberries & Such is a small veganic farm stand in the Cowichan Valley near Duncan, selling blueberries, produce, seeds, fruits, and nuts directly from the farm. The operation proudly bypasses retail middlemen entirely, with customers buying straight from the roadside stand. A cyclist passing through the valley in summer can expect seasonal BC-grown blueberries and other veganic farm goods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page confirms the business is real and active, with posts from July 2024 about blueberries being available at the farm stand. The page describes 'Veganic produce, seeds, fruits, nuts, etc...' confirming it sells fresh farm produce directly to customers. No evidence on the page or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM addr:housenumber field contains the full street address '4661 Bench Road' instead of just the number '4661', causing the rendered address to read '4661 Bench Road Bench Road' — OSM data entry error.
This appears to be a seasonal operation (summer blueberry season); no indication of year-round availability.
Only a Facebook page is available; no dedicated business website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active farm stand with confirmed 2024 activity; sells fresh local produce useful to touring cyclists passing through the Cowichan Valley.

wow_evidence: Veganic produce, seeds, fruits, nuts, etc...
